questions.prompt: Which of these are made from milk?
questions.fact: Margarine is made from vegetable oil, tofu from soybeans and coconut cream from coconut flesh. None of them has ever been near a cow.

questions.prompt: Which of these were written by Shakespeare?
questions.fact: Shakespeare invented or first wrote down around 1,700 English words, including lonely, bedroom and eyeball.

questions.prompt: How many countries are there in Africa?
questions.fact: 54, more than any other continent. Nigeria alone has more people than Germany, France and Spain put together.

questions.prompt: How many holes are played in a full round of golf?
questions.fact: Eighteen became the standard at St Andrews in 1764, when four short holes were merged into two.

questions.prompt: Which gas makes up most of the air we breathe?
questions.hint: It is not the one your body actually uses.
questions.fact: About 78% of the atmosphere is nitrogen. Oxygen is only about 21%.

questions.prompt: Which sea has no coastline at all?
questions.hint: Its edges are four ocean currents rather than land.
questions.fact: The Sargasso Sea sits inside the North Atlantic, bounded by currents instead of shores.
